I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread under Sofia's question. The answer is 10%.

Bettina's 12% note from November 17 was retracted minutes later in the same channel ("please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%"). I didn't quote the signed amendment or order form to Sofia. Finance documents go only to the approvers and the account owner, and Bettina took over the account in October 2025. The reply tells her to confirm against the signed paperwork with June Osei-Lark.
